svg.title: Backup and restore
svg.desc: Keep a recoverable copy before changing an installation.

g.text: Keep a recoverable copy before changing an installation.
Complete supported-FMER backups include musical banks, projects, working state, MIDI and personal FX default.
Keep dated archives per named instrument. Manage one connected unit at a time.
Restore is a verified overlay: empty source slots do not silently erase destination slots.
Actual Companion browser capture / example library / no unit connected
